images.description: A man and a woman, both wearing white cowboy hats, stand with their backs to the camera looking out over a green pasture where several black cattle graze, with a white barn and tree line visible in the background at dusk.
images.caption: Two ranchers observe a herd of cattle in a pasture at Boyd Station, Ky., June 10, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A middle-aged man in a blue short-sleeve shirt and glasses sits at a booth looking at his phone, with a bowl of soup, a plate of rice, and a red Coca-Cola cup on the table before him, a school bus and overcast sky visible through the window behind him.
images.caption: A man dines at a restaurant at Boyd Station, Ky., June 11, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: Close portrait of a middle-aged man in a blue shirt and glasses looking directly into the camera with a neutral expression, seated against a gray wood-paneled wall.
images.caption: A man is photographed in portrait at a restaurant at Boyd Station, Ky., June 11, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A young man in a black t-shirt and navy cap leans sideways against the corner of a building at dusk, his reflection visible in the window glass beside him, with a parking lot and commercial buildings in the background.
images.caption: A young man leans against a building exterior at dusk at Boyd Station, Ky., June 11, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: Two young women and a young man walk side by side on a narrow road flanked by dense green trees and brush at dusk, one holding a phone that glows in the dim light, a road sign visible in the distance.
images.caption: Three young people walk a rural road at dusk at Boyd Station, Ky., June 11, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: Three people, an older woman with gray hair in a pink top, a younger woman in a brown tank top with tattoos, and a young man in a multicolored striped shirt, lean toward each other in conversation at a wooden bar, with bottles and shelves of liquor filling the background.
images.caption: Patrons converse at a bar at Boyd Station, Ky., June 11, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: Four people, a young man in a striped shirt, a man in black, a woman with dark hair gesturing in conversation, and a woman in pink, stand around a wooden bar top in a warmly lit bar with artwork and shelving visible in the background.
images.caption: Patrons gather at a bar at Boyd Station, Ky., June 11, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A person pours syrup from a mason jar over a plate of golden waffles topped with raspberries and blueberries on a kitchen table, with a crystal fruit bowl, coffee mug, and additional waffle plates visible in a yellow-walled kitchen.
images.caption: Waffles and fresh fruit are prepared for breakfast at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A man in a red cap and blue t-shirt kneels on the roadside using a lug wrench to change a tire on a gray minivan, while a woman in a red bandana stands watching in the background, with green summer foliage and a road caution sign visible.
images.caption: A man changes a flat tire on a rural road at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A man in a blue t-shirt and jeans walks across a two-lane rural road balancing a large zebra-print item on his shoulders, nearly obscuring his face, as green summer trees line both sides of the winding road and a pickup truck is parked nearby.
images.caption: A man carries a large item across a rural road at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: Alternate frame of the same man crossing the road with a large zebra-print item balanced overhead, with open sky, green vegetation, and a white pickup truck visible in the background.
images.caption: A man walks down a rural road while carrying a large item at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A stylist in a pink shirt and purple gloves works on a seated client's blond hair inside a teal-walled salon, photographed through a mirror reflecting the salon's shelves, floral decor, and a colorful cake display in the background.
images.caption: A stylist applies color to a client's hair at a salon at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A stylist in a pink top and purple gloves applies product to a blond client's hair, both visible in the salon mirror, with a teal wall, tropical leaf wallpaper, and salon products on the counter surrounding them.
images.caption: A stylist works on a client's hair in a salon at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A male stylist in a white t-shirt and gray apron lifts a client's dark wet hair with one hand while directing a pink blow-dryer with the other, the client seated in a salon chair against a teal-painted wall.
images.caption: A stylist blow-dries a client's hair in a salon at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A stylist in a pink sweater and purple gloves smiles while separating a client's blond hair for coloring, inside a salon with yellow walls, floral overhead decorations, and a colorful circus-themed display visible through the open back door.
images.caption: A stylist applies highlights to a client's hair in a salon at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: Close-up of a dark mixing bowl filled with blue-tinted hair color and two combs resting across it in the foreground, with a blurred stylist in pink working on a client in the background against teal salon walls.
images.caption: Hair color is mixed in a bowl at a salon at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A musician with curly red hair strums an acoustic guitar and sings into a microphone on stage at the Aeolian Music Hall, with a metal star decoration on a brick wall behind them and a second guitarist partially visible to the right.
images.caption: A guitarist performs at the Aeolian Music Hall at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: Three musicians perform on a small stage at the Aeolian Music Hall, with a woman in a floral dress and tan cowboy hat standing left, a man in a white shirt and red cowboy hat playing guitar at center, and a third guitarist sitting to the right as the glowing red neon 'Aeolian Music Hall' sign appears behind them.
images.caption: A trio performs at the Aeolian Music Hall at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: Wide-angle view of three performers on the Aeolian Music Hall stage, with a woman in a floral dress and hat standing left, a man in a red cowboy hat playing guitar at center, and a bearded guitarist seated right as the red neon sign glows behind them and bar lights reflect in the foreground surface.
images.caption: Musicians perform at the Aeolian Music Hall at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A woman wearing a wide-brimmed tan hat sings into a microphone while playing acoustic guitar at the Aeolian Music Hall, with the red neon sign partially visible behind her and a second musician in a red cowboy hat visible to the right.
images.caption: A vocalist plays guitar at the Aeolian Music Hall at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A tattooed guitarist in a white shirt and red cowboy hat sings passionately into a microphone while strumming an acoustic guitar, with a star wall decoration, string lights, and foliage visible on the brick stage backdrop.
images.caption: A guitarist in a red cowboy hat performs at the Aeolian Music Hall at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A bearded guitarist in a black t-shirt and cap plays an acoustic guitar while seated on stage at the Aeolian Music Hall, a gold metal star decoration on the brick wall behind him and a microphone stand in front.
images.caption: A seated guitarist performs at the Aeolian Music Hall at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: Viewed from behind the silhouetted audience, two performers, a woman in a hat and floral dress and a man in a red cowboy hat, play guitars on a small stage with the red neon 'Aeolian Music Hall' sign glowing between them.
images.caption: Musicians perform for a crowd at the Aeolian Music Hall at Boyd Station, Ky., June 12, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: Low-angle view across a wildflower meadow at golden hour, with white and pink blossoms filling the foreground and rolling green hills, trees, and a pale blue sky stretching toward the horizon.
images.caption: Wildflowers bloom across a hillside meadow at Boyd Station, Ky., June 9, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: An older man in a gray long-sleeve shirt and tan cap ties a fishing rig while a younger man in an orange sweater and Pittsburgh Pirates cap watches closely, both standing on a grassy hillside at dusk.
images.caption: Two men prepare a fishing line at dusk at Boyd Station, Ky., June 9, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A boy in a blue t-shirt and cap swings a lit sparkler, producing a bright flare and swirl of smoke in the foreground, with a faint moon visible above dark tree silhouettes and a lit outbuilding in the background.
images.caption: A boy swings a sparkler in the night sky at Boyd Station, Ky., June 9, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: Close alternate frame of an adult and boy holding a sparkler together in the near-dark; the warm glow of the sparkler lights their hands and faces against a blue dusk sky.
images.caption: A boy watches a sparkler burn at Boyd Station, Ky., June 9, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: An adult in a brown hoodie stands beside a boy in a blue t-shirt and flag-patch cap as the boy holds a glowing sparkler in his cupped hands, illuminating both their faces against a deep blue twilight sky and tree silhouettes.
images.caption: A boy holds a sparkler with an adult at Boyd Station, Ky., June 9, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

images.description: A young person in a blue t-shirt and tan cap holds a sparkler at arm's length, tracing a glowing arc through the dark night air, with trails of sparks and smoke visible against a black background.
images.caption: A youth waves a sparkler in an arc at Boyd Station, Ky., June 9, 2025. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)
